rules.statement: The claim of the respondents was proved and could not be questioned further after the Supreme Court's decision.
rules.supporting_quote: "The appeal, is from this order. The only ground urged at the hearing of this appeal was that the claim of the respondents had not been proved, and in support of this the appellants rely on the wording of the appeal by the respondents from the order of February 15, 1927, ordering the expunging of their claims. The grounds upon which the learned District Judge had acted were not sufficient, even if they were right, to justify the order which he made."
